lead.event: Bayan Resources reshuffles its board at an extraordinary shareholders meeting
lead.headline: BYAN reshuffles board after Jhonlin takes 30.25% stake
lead.blurb: Bayan Resources appointed Ary Bastari president director, replacing Low Tuck Kwong, at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on 23 November after Jhonlin Baratama completed its stake acquisition. Jhonlin now holds 10.08 billion shares, or 30.25% of the company, while Low retains 9.95% and Elaine Low 22.05%. The meeting also appointed new directors and commissioners, with the changes taking effect when it closed. Management said the changes would have no material negative impact on the business.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Syariah Indonesia reports Q3 2026 net profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BRIS reports 10.02% growth in nine-month net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia disbursed Rp344.14 trillion in financing, up 14.61%, while third-party funds rose 10.81% to Rp386.07 trillion. Faster financing growth lifted its financing-to-deposit ratio to 90.04% from 86.29% a year earlier.

earnings_guidance.event: Archi Indonesia reports a 54.57% net profit increase
earnings_guidance.headline: ARCI reports 54.57% net profit increase
earnings_guidance.blurb: For the period ended 30 September 2026, Archi Indonesia reported net profit of USD108.93 million, up from USD70.47 million a year earlier. Revenue from customer contracts rose 39.7% to USD459.2 million, while basic earnings per share increased to USD0.0043 from USD0.0028.

deals_control.event: TBIG signs agreement to acquire EDOTCO Infrastruktur Indonesia
deals_control.headline: TBIG signs agreement to acquire 100% of EDOTCO Infrastruktur Indonesia
deals_control.blurb: Tower Bersama signed the SPA on 23 November with Axiata Group, EDOTCO Group and EDOTCO Malaysia. Completion remains subject to conditions precedent, and the transaction value has not been disclosed.
